Subject: Targeted Skills Bridge: Office Hours & Short-form Training Plan

Hi Sarah / Paul —

Thanks again for a great kickoff yesterday. Per our handoff checklist, I sketched a short enablement sequence designed to get your engineers productive with the Redwood API and Dedicated deployment patterns within two weeks. The goal is "just-in-time" training: focused 30–45 minute sessions plus 1-hour office hours so your team can bring real integration questions.

Proposed sequence (lightweight):
- Week 1: Two 30-min Skill Bridges (API basics + Authentication & Key management)
- Week 2: One 45-min Skill Bridge (KV caching & latency tuning) + 1-hour Office Hours (live Q&A / integration support)
- Deliverables: short recordings, step-by-step integration checklist, a shared folder with config samples and runbook snippets.

Attachments: medicore-enablement-agenda.pdf (agenda + roles), shortform-demo-checklist.md (demo checklist)
Shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cENABLEMENT_MEDICORE

Ask from our side: please confirm the two primary engineering attendees (names + time zone) and whether the compliance/security lead should join the KV caching session — we will surface the data retention and audit-log snippets.

Next step: if that works, I’ll post three candidate time blocks and Marissa will prepare a short, tailored demo for your tokenization and prefix-caching pattern.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
